title: Unpopular opinion: "what are we?"
old_caption: Scorpio calmly says asking "what are we?" isn't scary, and the crush in the crowd raises a hand. Would you ask first, or wait to be asked?

title: Choose Your Cuffing-Season Character
old_caption: Gemini has two plans in one night, Capricorn has a five-year plan by date two, and the cursor picks the mirror. Who are you choosing this winter?

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: telling the friends
old_caption: Gemini went from "met someone… anyway" to a thirty-slide presentation. The friends already had a banner made. The group chat always knows first.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: meet the family
old_caption: Cancer slipped an extra plate onto the table "for a friend". Turns out Mom set that place ages ago, cushion and all. Who's bringing someone home this year?

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: "I like you"
old_caption: Aries tried "you're cool, I guess", then a giant banner, then finally put both down and said it quietly, face to face. Guess which one worked.

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the group photo
old_caption: Libra takes everyone's holiday photo and never ends up in one. This year the friends pulled them into the frame. Who's the photographer in your group?

title: Soft launch vs hard launch: the nickname
old_caption: Capricorn tried "hey… you", then a cake iced MY SWEETPEA, then simply asked what they like to be called. The answer was sweeter than the cake.

title: Delulu or solulu: they laughed at my joke
old_caption: Two laughs and one "you're funny" and Leo had the meter pinned on delulu. Then Leo asked about Friday. What's the smallest sign you've ever over-read?

title: Delulu or solulu: "see you around"
old_caption: "See you around" had Pisces planning a whole future, and crying about it, obviously. One brave question later, around means Saturday.

title: Delulu or solulu: we both like hiking
old_caption: Same trail, same snack, same sunrise photo, and Sagittarius had already called it fate. One question did more than fate ever could. Snacks are non-negotiable.
